newsitem.title: ITALY: Aeroporti di Roma to set share price on July 7.
newsitem.headline: Aeroporti di Roma to set share price on July 7.

text.p: Aeroporti di Roma, the state-controlled company which runs Rome's airports, will hold a meeting on July 7 to set a share price for its forthcoming flotation, the government said on Wednesday.
The company, which is 73.58 percent owned by state industrial holding Iri, asked bourse watchdog Consob in March for permission to make an initial share offering.
The total stake on offer was not yet known but Iri has said it will be between 25.62 and 49 percent.
The privatisation is expected to take the form of a public sale offer (OPV) on the bourse and a private placement with institutional investors.
Aeroporti di Roma boosted its net profits by 61 percent in 1996 to 90 billion lire and increased its turnover 11 percent to 1.16 trillion lire. -- Rome Newsroom +396 6782501
